## Problem
What are you trying to achieve, and what is missing?

## Proposed solution
Describe the behavior you would like and whether it concerns the extension, CLI,
or both. For scoring changes, explain the objective or constraints.

## Alternatives
Describe any alternatives considered.

## Additional context
Examples or screenshots, if useful. Do not include personal account data.
